entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The muscular bald person in the image-left foreground, facing away from the camera, with a broad red marking across the light-colored shoulders and back, wearing brown leather protective gear.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The person with long black hair in the central midground, wearing a green fitted outfit and gray-blue hanging panels, holding Weapon C with the bow drawn toward image-right.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: The short-haired person straddling Animal A, wearing a light gray-blue top and dark pants.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The large gray-brown quadruped in the image-right midground, with thick curved horns, blue eyes, golden armor plates, and a saddle.

entities.name: Dark Red Tree Canopy
entities.identification: The dark red and pink clusters of leaves and dark branching limbs at the top and upper left of the image.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The slender spear-like weapon beside Person A, angled toward the upper right, with a silver tip and hanging dark red cloth.

entities.name: Orange-Patterned Object Lying on the Ground
entities.identification: The low-lying, irregular orange-brown object on the ground between Person B and Animal A, with dark patterns on its surface.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: The broad silver-gray axe head and long brown handle on the image-right side of Person A's back.

entities.name: Weapon C
entities.identification: The slender, nearly vertical bow held by Person B, with alternating dark and light patterns on the bow and a thin string pulled back.

entities.name: Stone-Framed Wooden-Stake Gate
entities.identification: The dark green-gray rectangular stone frame in the background and the uneven orange-brown wooden stakes within it.

entities.name: Torch Beside the Gate
entities.identification: The yellow-orange flames and portions of supporting rods on both sides of the Stone-Framed Wooden-Stake Gate, treated as one group according to the source entity.

entities.name: Gray Stone Wall
entities.identification: The gray stone facades at the rear of the courtyard and on the image-right side, with joints between stone blocks, mottled surfaces, and dark areas.

entities.name: Gnarled Vines on the Wall
entities.identification: The thick light gray-brown roots, thin vines, and green clinging plants winding along the wall.

entities.name: Courtyard Stone-Paved Ground
entities.identification: The irregular blue-gray-green stone slabs, gravel, and reddish-brown strip-like paving band in the lower part of the image.

entities.name: Ground Moss
entities.identification: The green grass clumps, ground-hugging moss-like cover, and a small number of broad leaves in the stone gaps and across the midground surface.

entities.name: Courtyard Fungal Clusters
entities.identification: The collection of red-orange and pink fungi on the courtyard ground, with overlapping fan-shaped and umbrella-shaped small pieces interspersed among grass blades.

entities.name: Weapon D
entities.identification: The long silver-gray curved-blade-like weapon slanting across Person A's back, with a dark brown wrapped grip at its upper end.
